test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is India's best known Global brand as per Brand Finance’s 'India 100-2020 ranking’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Tata Group **is the only Indian brand to make the **Brand Finance Global 500**, 2020 - a list of the world's 500 most valuable brands – top 100.
 
• Tata Group has a genuinely global reach, operating in over 100 countries across six continents and employing over 720,000 people.
 
• **Tata Motors, Tata Steel, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), **its financial services, and retail divisions are expected to account for 10-15 percent of the Group's profits as a result of the Group's strategic choice to utilize the strength of its flagship operational firms.
 
• According to Brand Finance, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has become the world's second most valuable IT services brand, while Infosys and four other Indian IT giants have solidified their positions among the top 25 IT services brands.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **​Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)** is a Mumbai-based Indian multinational information technology (IT) services and consulting firm. It is a subsidiary of the Tata Group, with 149 locations in 46 countries.
 
• **Tata Consultancy Services** Limited was created in **1968 **by a branch of Tata Sons Limited as "Tata Computer Systems."
 
• TCS became the first Indian IT company to reach a market capitalization of $200 billion on September 15, 2021.
